decisionsTitle: «Eticheta pe BIB»: a label for every elite bib, the first name by default; elites marked at the desk; «Participanți» folds
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-18, with screenshots of the registrations list, the elite list and the race-day desk:** «partea asta cu toți participanții trebuie să fie colapsabilă» · «aici la lista de Elite vreau să customizez cum apare pe BIB, dacă pun doar prenume sau cum afișez de fapt. Deci în dreptul fiecăruia vreau un „BIB Label” și să fie prenumele by default» · «ce am acum pe această pagină [Ziua cursei] e de fapt „Prezența” și aici trebuie să marchez dacă cineva e elită și cum apare pe BIB» · «trebuie să faci aceste schimbări eficient și rapid!». The race is on Saturday, so the desk behaves as before for every role but where this section says.

**Decision — «Eticheta pe BIB» (amends §948 and §963).** What an elite bib prints where the number goes is no longer the first name alone (a registration, §948) or the first word (a line of the list, §963): it is a label per line, typed by the Administrator, and those two are now only its **default**. Two nullable columns, migration `0214_elite_bib_label` (expand only): `registrations.elite_bib_label` and `event_elite_entries.bib_label`, each CHECK 1 to `ELITE_NAME_MAX` (80) characters. Null is the default and today's rule unchanged, so nothing prints differently until somebody types a label. The label in force is decided once, in `bib-elite.ts` (`eliteBibName`, `eliteLineBibName`; the defaults `eliteDefaultLabel`, `eliteLineDefaultLabel`): the sheet (`bibs-pdf.ts`), the picture (the preview route) and every screen read it from there.

The write — `elite-label.ts`, `setRegistrationEliteBibLabel` and `setEliteEntryBibLabel` — is the Administrator's alone (`canManageRegistrations`, the elite mark's own gate, §897), asserted at each action's door and again in the service (BR-REQ-060-01): the Organizer reads the label on the card, every desk role reads it on the row, nobody else writes it. The value is trimmed with its inner spaces collapsed; empty, or equal to the default, stores null — back to the default, so a corrected first name is followed again; longer than `ELITE_NAME_MAX` is refused naming the box (`ELITE_LABEL_TOO_LONG`, a sentence with the limit). A press that finds the label as asked writes nothing; otherwise one statement under the row's lock and one audit row — `registration.elite_bib_label_set` on the registration with no metadata, `event_elite.bib_label_set` on the event with `{ entryId }` — never the label, which is a person's name. A registration's label stays while its elite mark is off — inert, as the §910 ticks are — and prints again when it is marked. It is the person's data: deleted with the registration's erasure, named in «Toate datele unei persoane» (page and file list every column), never read by a public query, the public lists («Elitele cursei» stays the name and the number), an export of the event, a copy or the event file; the registrations' CSV and Excel carry no elite mark, so they carry no label either. A list line's label is the club's typed text, as the line's name is. A fingerprint of the label rides in the picture's address (`bibPictureSrc`'s `l=`), never the label itself, so a changed label is a fresh picture and the request log holds no name.

**The screens.** On «Elită — doar numele pe BIB» (the editor's «Alocare și tipărire»), every line — a name of the list and a registration marked «Elită» alike — carries a box «Eticheta pe BIB» filled with the label in force, its placeholder the default, the help «Implicit: prenumele. Se tipărește mare, în locul numărului; cel mult 80 de caractere.», and «Salvează» (44 px): one small plain form a line beside the event's save form, working without scripts and coming back to the card open (`?saved=eliteLabelSaved`). A label too long comes back as the card's banner asking for a shorter one, the box showing the label in force again — rare, since the box itself stops at 80 characters. The Organizer sees «Pe BIB: …» instead of the box. The add form's box is now «Numele», and its help says the label is set on the line once added; every text that said only the first word or the first name prints (the editor's design intro, the elite mark's toast and trail) says the label instead.

**The desk («Prezența») — amends §897: the elite mark is pressed at the desk too, still the Administrator's.** On the row of a registration marked «Elită», beside the name, every desk role sees the chip «Elită» and «Pe BIB: {label}» — what the bib in the volunteer's hand says, a name the row already shows, never an address (§15.11). An Administrator also gets, at the end of every row, a small closed fold «Elită și BIB»: the elite mark's existing verb (`setRegistrationEliteAction`, posting the state it wants, «Marchează ca elită» / «Nu mai e elită») and, while marked, the label box with «Salvează»; both come back to the desk with its event, its search and the row, the outcome said in the desk's banner as its other presses say theirs (a label too long comes back in the row, the box still filled). Another role is never drawn the fold, and the actions and services refuse it anyway. The desk's own buttons, counts and order are unchanged; the fold is not drawn on a race that is over, where the desk offers no button.

**«Participanți».** The registrations list's table — with its results line, its pager and the batch verbs that act on its ticks — sits in one fold «Participanți» (the glyph of the registrations), open on every arrival (`primary`: the list is what the screen is for), its closed line the count the results line states. One fold for all of it, so the bulk form and the ticks it owns stay together; every row id, row menu and press works as before. Nothing else on the page moved.

**Left out, on purpose.** A label on an ordinary (non-elite) bib, or on an «Ambasador»'s, which prints as any other; a label typed at the moment a line is added (it is set on the line once added — one box fewer on the add form); a label on the registration's own page or the list's «⋮» (the card and the desk are where the bib is decided and handed); a bulk edit of labels; showing the label anywhere public; the desk's fold for the Organizer or a volunteer; the label in the registrations' CSV or Excel, which carry no elite mark to stand beside; the label in an event's copy or file, which carry no elite list.
changelogLine: - **«Eticheta pe BIB» for every elite bib, elites at the desk, and the participants' table in a fold** — each line of «Elită — doar numele pe BIB» and each registration marked «Elită» gets a box for what its bib prints where the number goes, the first name by default; the race-day desk shows «Elită» and «Pe BIB: …» on an elite's row and lets an Administrator mark an elite and change the label there; the registrations list's table, pager and batch verbs sit in one fold «Participanți», open by default. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 123 and 130 (the first-name rule of §948 and the first-word rule of §963). Given a registration marked «Elită» or a line of the race's elite list, then its elite bib prints, where the number goes, the line's «Eticheta pe BIB» when one is stored and otherwise the default — the registration's first name (the registered name for a row that keeps none), the line's first word — on the sheet and in the picture alike, decided once by `bib-elite.ts`; with no label typed every bib prints exactly as before (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an Administrator who types «Eticheta pe BIB» on a line of «Elită — doar numele pe BIB» or at the desk, then the value is stored trimmed with its inner spaces collapsed; empty, or equal to the default, stores nothing (back to the default); longer than 80 characters is refused naming the box with nothing written; each change writes one audit row naming the registration, or the event and the line's id, never the label; a registration's label stays while its elite mark is off and prints again when it is marked; it is deleted with the registration's erasure, listed in «Toate datele unei persoane», and read by no public query, list, export of the event, copy or event file (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the Organizer, Tehnic, the Redactor or a desk Volunteer, when they post «Eticheta pe BIB» for a registration or a line of the elite list, or the elite mark from the desk, then the action and the service each refuse it (FORBIDDEN) and nothing is written, no audit row included (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the race-day desk, then the row of a registration marked «Elită» shows the chip «Elită» and «Pe BIB: {label}» beside the name to every staff role, and only an Administrator's row ends in a closed fold «Elită și BIB» holding the elite mark's verb (posting the state it wants) and, while marked, the label box; each press comes back to the desk with its event, its search and the row, and the bib's picture is asked under a new address after a label changes (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registrations list, then its table, its results line, its pager and the batch cancel and erase that act on its ticks sit in one fold «Participanți», open on arrival, whose closed line is the count the results line states; every row's menu and the batch forms work as before (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
